Easy win: Remove unused website blocks and connect the newsletter form
Why it helps: It removes visible layout errors so your website looks professional and trustworthy to visitors.
First step: Log into Squarespace, set up a storage location for your newsletter list, and hide any unconfigured page blocks.

Easy win: Add your registered business name and ABN to the website footer
Why it helps: Displaying official registration details helps visitors easily verify that your business is genuine.
First step: Open your global footer settings in Squarespace and type in your registered business name and ABN.

Easy win: Display a direct business phone number on your website
Why it helps: It gives people who feel uncomfortable with online forms a simple and direct way to reach out.
First step: Add a dedicated phone number to the header and contact sections of your website.

Easy win: Publish clear service boundary disclaimers on your site
Why it helps: It ensures clients understand that your sessions provide helpful guidance and education rather than legal or financial advice.
First step: Draft a straightforward description of your educational services to share during initial client calls.

Easy win: Create and verify a Google Business Profile for the Perth area
Why it helps: It allows local community members to discover your services when searching online for nearby help.
First step: Set up your Google Business Profile using your registered location while keeping your personal street address private.

Easy win: Add direct online booking for your free introductory call
Why it helps: It makes it simple and quick for prospective clients to choose a time that suits them best.
First step: Connect an online calendar tool to your website so visitors can directly pick an available time.

Easy win: Join the national Be Connected network as an official community partner
Why it helps: It connects you with a recognised government-backed initiative that supports digital literacy for seniors.
First step: Submit an application to be listed as a Digital Mentor through the Be Connected portal.

Easy win: Prepare a downloadable presentation guide for community organisations
Why it helps: It provides community groups and organisations with a clear summary of the tailored workshops you offer.
First step: Organise your session topics into a clean, easy-to-read overview document.
